pictures.name: EL1-Desert-Flight
pictures.prompt: A vast rocky desert wilderness at dusk, endless dunes and stony hills, distant purple mountains. Small in the middle of the frame, far away, a lone man in a rough brown camel-hair mantle with a leather belt and a wooden staff, seen only from behind, walking away from us toward the mountains, weary. Long blue shadows, last gold light on the rocks. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: EL2-Broom-Tree
pictures.prompt: The desert at dawn. Under a small lone broom tree with thin green branches, a lone man in a rough brown camel-hair mantle with a leather belt and a wooden staff, seen only from behind, lies curled asleep on the sand, his mantle drawn over him. Beside him on warm flat stones rests a round loaf of bread and a clay jar of water. A soft beam of golden light falls from above onto the bread, no figure in it. Peaceful, tender. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
